beats.text: Duolingo is a free app for learning languages.
beats.note: It is. But it was built to make money another way.

beats.name: Luis von Ahn and Severin Hacker
beats.role: The idea came from Carnegie Mellon. Von Ahn had already worked on reCAPTCHA, which used people to digitise books.

beats.note: The translations were then sold to media companies.
BuzzFeed's system sent an article to Duolingo once it became popular enough.

beats.context: More than this many a day were translated by students, according to a report from April 2014.

beats.note: The English test, advertising and subscriptions took over the translation service.

beats.text: The lessons were the product. The learners were the workforce.
